description: Toybox 10K wave 2 birds: bluebird, thrush, wren, baby_bird, parrot, budgie, crow, pigeon, puffin, goose, fairy_godmother, gosling, mommy_duck, cockerel, peacock (fan opens and closes), woodpecker, hummingbird, toucan, swallow, swift, eagle and red_kite (variants of hawk), heron, ostrich and emu. Every bird has a named mirrored wing and a tail. **Generated** by tools/gen_tk_birds.mjs: edit the generator and rerun it, not the JSON.

bluebird.description: A small round toy bluebird, about 0.8 m tall at size 1: a soft blue back and head, a pale cream chest, a short gold beak (it drops a lower beak to talk), button eyes and blush. Named parts: wing (mirrored, flaps; turn one up with point, or [0, 0, -20] to tuck it), tail (lift it with [20, 0, 0]). Faces +z.

thrush.description: A song thrush: a small toy bird, about 0.9 m tall at size 1, with a warm brown back and head, a cream chest speckled with brown spots, a short gold beak (talks with a dropping lower beak) and bright eyes. Named parts: wing (mirrored), tail. Variant of bluebird.

wren.description: A tiny round toy wren, about 0.65 m tall at size 1: chestnut brown with a tan chest, bright eyes, a short gold beak (talks with a dropping lower beak) and a little tail cocked straight up. Named parts: wing (mirrored), tail (cocked up; wiggle it about x). Variant of bluebird.

baby_bird.description: A tiny fluffy gray-blue baby bird, about 0.5 m tall at size 1: a round fuzzy body, a pale sky-blue tummy, a little tuft on top and a wide yellow beak that opens wide for food when it talks. Named parts: wing (mirrored, little stubs), tail. Sits nicely in the catalog `nest` prop. Faces +z.

parrot.description: A bright toy parrot, about 1.05 m tall at size 1, standing upright: a green body, a red head with white eye patches, a curved cream beak (it drops a lower beak to talk), red-and-blue wing tips, a long blue-and-red tail and gray perching feet. Named parts: wing (mirrored), tail. Bob #head to copy words. Faces +z.

budgie.description: A small toy budgie, about 0.75 m tall at size 1: a green body, a sunny yellow head with blue cheek spots and little black throat dots, a short curved cream beak (talks with a dropping lower beak), teal wing tips and tail. Named parts: wing (mirrored), tail. Variant of parrot.

crow.description: A glossy black toy crow, about 1.05 m tall at size 1, with a friendly round face, big cartoon eyes, a little yellow beak (it drops a lower beak to talk), a red showman's bow tie and yellow feet. Named parts: wing (mirrored, flaps), tail, bow_tie (drop it in a variant). Rainbow feathers: give it a `recolor` such as { ink: "purple" }. Faces +z.

pigeon.description: A small gray toy town pigeon, about 0.9 m tall at size 1: soft gray body, a shimmering teal-and-purple neck, bright orange eyes, a little dark beak with a white tip (talks with a dropping lower beak), dark wing bars, pink feet and rosy cheeks for blushing. Named parts: wing (mirrored), tail. Variant of crow.

puffin.description: A small black-and-white toy puffin, about 0.85 m tall at size 1: a black back, wings and cap, a white face disc and chest, a tall flat orange beak with a gold stripe at its base (it drops a lower beak to talk) and bright orange feet. Named parts: wing (mirrored; clap them with a quick flap), tail. Faces +z.

goose.description: A white farmyard toy goose, about 1.25 m tall at size 1: a plump body, a long curved neck, a small round head with kind eyes, an orange beak with a little knob (it drops a lower beak to talk), wide white wings and big orange feet. Named parts: wing (mirrored), tail. Faces +z.

fairy_godmother.description: A kind fairy godmother played by an old white goose (the goose model) in a purple starry shawl with a gold trim and round gold glasses, about 1.25 m tall at size 1. Named parts: wing (mirrored, as goose), tail, shawl, glasses. Her sparkling wand is the `magic_wand` prop parented by the script: parent: "<id>", part: "wing", at about [0.06, -0.3, 0.12], rotation [-60, 0, 0], size 0.6.

gosling.description: A fluffy toy gosling (a baby goose), about 0.6 m tall at size 1: a soft yellow body with a gray-olive back and crown, a short neck, big dark eyes, a tiny orange beak (talks with a dropping lower beak) and big soft orange feet. Named parts: wing (mirrored, little stubs), tail. Faces +z.

mommy_duck.description: Mommy Duck: a grown-up toy duck, about 1.2 m tall at size 1, the same round shape as the yellow duck: a soft brown body with a cream chest, a soft green stripe around her neck, a blue wing patch, an orange bill (it drops a lower bill to talk) and orange feet. Named parts: wing (mirrored), tail. Leads ducklings (the `duck` or `chick` at size 0.5). Faces +z.

cockerel.description: A proud toy cockerel (a rooster), about 1.35 m tall at size 1: a red body, a gold head and neck ruff, a tall red comb and wattle, a gold beak (it drops a lower beak to talk), brown-and-gold wings, a high curling tail of dark green and black feathers and yellow legs. Named parts: wing (mirrored), tail, comb. Faces +z.

peacock.description: A proud toy peacock, about 1.25 m tall at size 1 with the fan folded and 1.75 m with it open: a shimmering blue body and neck, a little crest, a white eye stripe, brown-barred wings and long gray legs, and a huge green fan tail with gold-and-teal eye spots. Named parts: wing (mirrored), tail (the whole fan, pivot at the rump), fan (the outer feathers). The fan rests OPEN and upright. To fold it: turn `#fan` to [0, 0, 50] (the outer feathers swing in behind the middle ones) and `#tail` to [-62, 0, 0] (it lowers back into a train); turn both back to [0, 0, 0] to open it. Faces +z.

woodpecker.description: A small toy woodpecker, about 0.85 m tall at size 1, standing upright: a black back and wings with white spots, a white face and chest, a bright red cap on the back of its head, a straight gray beak (it drops a lower beak to talk) and a stiff black tail it props itself on. Tap a tree by turning `#head` [20, 0, 0] and back quickly. Named parts: wing (mirrored), tail. Faces +z.

hummingbird.description: A tiny ruby-throated toy hummingbird, about 0.6 m tall at size 1: a shimmering green back and head, a white chest, a red throat patch, a long thin beak (it drops a thin lower beak to talk) and long narrow wings held up. The wings idle gently (under 1 Hz): to hover, lift it with `at` and flap `#wing` slowly ([0, 0, ±30] about 1-2 times a second), never a fast flicker. Named parts: wing (mirrored), tail. Faces +z.

toucan.description: A black toy toucan, about 1.0 m tall at size 1: a black body, a white throat and chest, a blue patch around each kind eye, a huge light orange beak with a yellow top ridge and a dark tip (it drops a yellow lower beak to talk), a red patch under the tail and blue feet. Named parts: wing (mirrored), tail. Faces +z.

swallow.description: A small toy swallow, about 0.7 m tall at size 1: a dark blue back, head and long pointed wings, a cream chest, a little black beak (it drops a lower beak to talk) and a long forked tail. Named parts: wing (mirrored, long and swept back), tail (both streamers). A tiny splint for a hurt wing can be added in a variant (a white `sphere` named splint on the wing). Faces +z.

swift.description: A dark toy swift, about 0.7 m tall at size 1: sooty dark gray all over, a tiny black beak (talks with a dropping lower beak), long sickle-shaped crescent wings held out to the sides as it glides and a short forked tail. Named parts: wing (mirrored), tail. Variant of swallow; it races over rooftops (move it with `at`) and rarely lands.

eagle.description: A big gentle toy bald eagle, about 1.35 m tall at size 1: a dark brown body and wide brown wings, a white head and a white fan tail, a yellow hooked beak and yellow feet, big kind eyes. Named parts: wing (mirrored; spread them with [0, 0, 70]), tail. Variant of hawk (bigger, darker, white tail).

red_kite.description: A large toy red kite, about 1.15 m tall at size 1: a russet-brown body, a pale gray head, long angled wings with dark tips, a deeply forked russet tail (it twists to steer: turn `#tail` [0, 0, ±15]), a gold hooked beak and yellow feet. Named parts: wing (mirrored), tail. Variant of hawk.

heron.description: A tall calm toy gray heron, about 1.7 m tall at size 1: a long gray body with darker wing tips, a white chest plume, a long white curved neck, a white head with a black crest plume, small round glasses, a long gold beak (it drops a lower beak to talk) and long thin gold legs. Named parts: wing (mirrored), tail, glasses, leg_left, leg_right (each turns about the hip: [±20, 0, 0] to wade). Faces +z.

ostrich.description: A tall friendly toy ostrich, about 2.0 m tall at size 1 (it stands well above the bear): a big fluffy black body with white wing and tail plumes, a long bare pink neck, a small round head with big curious eyes, a wide flat beak (it drops a lower beak to talk) and long bare pink legs. Named parts: wing (mirrored), tail, leg_left, leg_right (each leg turns about the hip: [±25, 0, 0] to stride). Faces +z.

emu.description: A tall friendly toy emu, about 1.85 m tall at size 1: a shaggy brown body, a gray-blue neck and face, curious brown eyes, a wide flat beak (talks with a dropping lower beak) and long gray legs. Named parts: wing (mirrored, small), tail, leg_left, leg_right (stride with [±25, 0, 0]). Variant of ostrich (all brown with a gray neck, a little shorter).
